findings.title: `self.paginate` called with unsupported `enable_advanced_features` keyword argument
findings.body: `OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint.get` passes `enable_advanced_features=True` directly to `self.paginate(...)`. `Endpoint.paginate` does not accept arbitrary keyword arguments for the paginator constructor (it takes `paginator_kwargs`), so requests with `optimized_pagination=true` from authorized users will fail with `TypeError: paginate() got an unexpected keyword argument 'enable_advanced_features'`.

findings.title: `OptimizedCursorPaginator` fails with `TypeError` when ordering by a `datetime` field
findings.body: `OrganizationAuditLogsEndpoint` configures `OptimizedCursorPaginator` with `order_by="-datetime"`, where `AuditLogEntry.datetime` is a `datetime` instance. Unlike `DateTimePaginator`, `OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_item_key` passes the field value directly to `math.floor(value)` / `math.ceil(value)` and `value_from_cursor` returns the raw numeric cursor value without converting to a `datetime`. Paginating `AuditLogEntry` records with `OptimizedCursorPaginator` will raise `TypeError: must be real number, not datetime.datetime` as soon as any results are processed.

findings.title: Negative slice bounds on Django `QuerySet` raise `ValueError`
findings.body: `OptimizedCursorPaginator.get_result` (lines 880-882) and the `cursor.is_prev` branch (lines 182-184 and 884-886) pass negative `start_offset` (and potentially negative `stop`) values directly into `queryset[start_offset:stop]`. Django `QuerySet.__getitem__` does not support negative indexing or slicing and immediately raises `ValueError: Negative indexing is not supported.`, causing a 500 error whenever a negative cursor offset is supplied.

findings.title: Potential `AttributeError` when `organization_context.member` is `None`
findings.body: On line 71, `organization_context.member.has_global_access` is evaluated whenever `request.user.is_superuser` is `False`. For requests authenticated via organization-level tokens or integrations (where `request.user` is an `AnonymousUser` and `organization_context.member` is `None`), accessing `.has_global_access` will raise an `AttributeError`.
